_comment: LTX-2.3 v1 shape menu (deepinfra). Two landscape shapes at 5s; each serves BOTH t2v and i2v (i2v rides the same compiled shape -- image conditioning is a per-token denoise mask, not a token-count change). Eager warm-on-boot warms exactly these. Adding/removing entries changes IMAGE_SHAPE_HASH and requires a new image tag + a matching per-model SUPPORTED_SHAPES in backend ltx.py (CI-checked). Dims MUST be multiples of 64: the LTX-2.3 two-stage refine stage requires height/width divisible by 64 (stricter than the VAE's 32) or it raises 'LTX-2 refinement requires height/width divisible by 64'. We round UP to the next 64-multiple so we never deliver fewer lines than the advertised resolution: 1080p -> 1920x1088 (1088=17*64, >=1080) and 720p -> 1280x768 (768=12*64, >=720). NOTE 1280x768 is 5:3, slightly taller than 16:9 (1080p is ~16:9); switch to 1344x768 if exact 16:9 is wanted. 10s (241f) and portrait deferred to a later menu.
